text: My education and qualifications are: I am seeking reelection to the Castro Valley Sanitary District Board of Directors to continue delivering the quiet excellence our community depends on. Think about the peace of mind you have when your sewer, recycling, and waste services work seamlessly. That quiet reliability does not happen by accident. Since 2021, I have proudly served on your Board, collaborating with our staff to ensure our award winning agency consistently delivers these essential daily services. As a longtime resident, neighbor, and retired Castro Valley teacher, I care deeply about our families and local businesses. My active involvement in our local community gives me a unique vantage point to represent you effectively as I set balanced policies, review long term master plans, and carefully protect your hard earned ratepayer dollars. By focusing on smart strategic planning, we keep our vital systems running smoothly while maintaining service rates among the lowest in Alameda County. This balanced management ensures our district remains transparent, responsive, and fiscally responsible while delivering exceptional value to our town. I am fully dedicated to protecting public health and our environment. I would be honored to have your support, and I respectfully ask for your vote.

text: My education and qualifications are: I’m a resident of Castro Valley for nearly 50 years and a ratepayer of Castro Valley Sanitary District (CVSan). I’ve been married for over 50 years, have 3 grown children and 7 grandchildren. I am a retired sewer contractor with over 2,000 residential sewer replacements and a number of sewer mains in the Bay Area. It’s time for change. As a sewer contractor for over 30 years, I am highly qualified to sit on the CVSan Board. If elected I will push for term limits and paying off CVSan’s 30-year Bonds that cost the ratepayers around $1 Million per year for the new CVSan building. I started night law school at age 46 and received my Juris Doctor and LL.M. in environmental studies and passed the Bar on the first try, all while working full time as a sewer contractor. I have been involved with CVSan and have attended many Board and Committee meetings since 2010, either in person or by Zoom. I was responsible for drafting regulations with others for the “inspection upon sale” CVSan program. I personally was able to get the initial requirements more reasonable and manageable. Please vote for Ken Owen. www.Facebook/CvsanBoardElection/

text: My education and qualifications are: I have served the Castro Valley Sanitary District for twenty six years and have helped guide the District on a course of responsible community service. I graduated from the University of California, Berkeley, am a Professional Civil Engineer and retired from the Alameda County Public Works Agency as Deputy Director of Public Works. My family and I have lived in Castro Valley for fifty years. My wife, Sherry, is retired from the Castro Valley Unified School District and both of our daughters graduated from Castro Valley High School.One daughter owns a small business (bakery) in Castro Valley. I am currently retired, so I have sufficient time to devote to the District’s management. My engineering background and management skills have helped me to actively participate on the Board and its committees. I sit on joint committees or Boards with the Oro Loma Sanitary District, East Bay Dischargers, Local Agency Formation Commission and the Alameda County Library Foundation. I have been able to work effectively with our Board members, staff, and the community to carry out the mission of the District, providing safe, low cost, and effective wastewater and solid waste management, while focusing on the best long term management of the District to preserve and enhance our investment in the sewage and solid waste systems.
